ve_token_id_nonzero.meaning: vault has a nonzero veTokenId so totalAssets() reflects the veNFT locked amount

prior_total_supply_positive.meaning: _totalSupply is greater than zero, i.e. not the first deposit

deposit_amount_positive.meaning: depositor calls deposit() with a positive HYBR amount

lock_before_calc.meaning: deposit() locks the HYBR into the veNFT before calculateShares(amount) is called

shares_underminted.meaning: depositor receives fewer gHYBR shares than fair proportional value

claims.scope: deposit() share-minting order in the gHYBR vault

preconditions.text: The vault has a nonzero veTokenId, so totalAssets() reflects the veNFT's locked amount.; There are existing depositors, i.e. _totalSupply is greater than zero (not the very first deposit).; A new depositor calls deposit() with a positive HYBR amount.; In deposit(), the contract locks the deposited HYBR into the veNFT before calculateShares(amount) is called.
preconditions.derivation: Program conjunction of selected report preconditions.

safety.text: In deposit(), the shares minted to a depositor should be computed on totalAssets() measured before that deposit's HYBR is locked, so a nonzero veTokenId and existing supply do not reduce the depositor's shares below the fair proportional amount.
safety.derivation: Program synthesis from the selected intent and logical pattern.

effects.text: A new depositor receives fewer gHYBR shares than fair value, e.g. 50 gHYBR instead of 100.
effects.derivation: Program-generated direct negation witness for the selected safety pattern.

effect_coverage.reason: Program-generated exact coverage for selected direct impact.

assumptions: calculateShares() is treated as the fair-value preview reference, so a fair deposit mints the amount implied by a pre-deposit totalAssets() reading (assume_preview_consistent).
Total assets include the veNFT locked amount plus deposited HYBR, and minting follows the ERC4626-style proportional formula against totalAssets() and _totalSupply.
The example 100 -> fair shares versus 50 shares actual is illustrative, not a concrete observed transaction.

limitations: Secondary consequence impact_existing_overreward (value redistributed to existing holders) is deferred as a downstream effect of the under-mint, not part of the core V.
No concrete transaction, block or address is given, so the plan is symbolic and no SMT model value is asserted.
Whether the depositor can preview calculateShares() before depositing is not covered by the selected core formula.
The exact numeric share-shortfall ratio (e.g., 100 vs 50) is an example and is not bound as a divisor relation.
